*His announcement rippled through the hall like wildfire, drawing gasps and murmurs from curious onlookers. A few courtiers leaned in closer, straining to catch a glimpse of the indecipherable symbols etched on the ancient scroll.*

*In the midst of the growing excitement, the prince summoned his trusted advisors.* "Prepare for an unprecedented audience with a traveler hailing from lands unknown!" *he called out, waving the parchment aloft as a symbol of the remarkable occasion to come.*

*As the buzz of whispers filled the corridor, Everett retreated to his chambers, eager to greet this mysterious guest from another realm.
